sources.title: PDF The AI Music Arms Race: On the Detection of AI-Generated Music
sources.snippet: ABSTRACT Several companies now offer platforms for users to create music at unprecedented scales by textual prompting. As the quality of this music rises, concern grows about how to differentiate AI-generated music from human-made music, with implications for content identification, copyright enforcement, and music recommendation sys-tems.
